text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'm starved.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I hunger for the passion to take a new,
bold step.
To run, more and more.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
This unfulfilled desire is what drives me
forward.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I want to live more... by running more.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
This is the place where I can achieve
that.

Narita Brian has managed to leave quite
a mark
on the Twinkle Series.

Together, we've successfully navigated
the crucial
first three years of her career.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: The ramps are finished, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian! Can I get an interview?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: All right.

It's been the case since even before the
Arima
Kinen, but the public's
expectations for Narita
Brian are only
increasing.

It makes sense, considering what she has

accomplished. But it's also difficult to
respond to
each and every request for
an interview.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ah. That would be more efficient.
choice_data_list: Maybe I should hold a press conference.
Maybe I'll hold a press conference.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph. ...I'll leave the details to you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'll prepare some comments in the
meantime.

And so, we decide to bring in multiple
media
outlets for questions.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Brian! How confident are you about
being
selected as the URA Umamusume
of the Year?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian! We'd love to hear about
your vision
for the future!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Let's talk rivals! Who do you consider
your
current rival, Brian?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Okay, one at a time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
First, regarding being Umamusume of
the Year... I
have no idea. That's for you
all to decide.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'm just going to keep running my own
way. I
guess that's my answer regarding
my vision for the
future too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Now, about my rival...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Every single racer out there is my rival.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
You mean, it's not only Hishi Amazon or
Biwa
Hayahide?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Of course.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Anyone can come and challenge me. But
I won't
hold back against any challenger.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'm aiming for everyone's necks!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: And also...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: ...Yes?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I got a question for you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Can I run in races abroad while I'm still
enrolled
here?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: N-nooo way! Brian, you're—
choice_data_list: You mean taking on the world stage?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I already told you, didn't I? Every single
racer in
the world is my rival.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I'd be relocating overseas.
There's
plenty of competitors to face in
the Twinkle
Series.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
But restricting myself only to the
Twinkle Series
would be a shame. I want
to challenge myself
even more.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
As long as there are competitors outside
this
country, I can't be satisfied. ...So,
how about it,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Press
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Well, that's that, then.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that was a pretty fun press
conference.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Still, all of that had to be said sooner or
later.
choice_data_list: Left me that much more exhausted, though...
It left me that much more exhausted, though...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: At any rate, I'm grateful to you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Heh, that's not what I meant.
choice_data_list: Prepping for a press conference is a piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Brian! One-on-one today, you and
me!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Don't forget me! Race me too, Brian!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Those two are here, huh? Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: All right.
choice_data_list: Go ahead, have a good run!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Whatever happens... always let me run.
